name: P-006 native carry builder restores pinned v1 and refreshes post-stamp mode in a fresh Codex context
command: Inside the disposable host: install v1, run a selected Codex model turn, install v2, restore the v1 home, enable IDEATE and warm-resume the model, call buildCarryDoc/renderCarryDoc for the exact owner, then enable AUTO and start a fresh Codex thread on the same home with the rendered carry document as its first prompt
summary: The carry builder produced a complete document containing IDEATE at control generation 3. AUTO was enabled after that stamp. A fresh Codex thread with the carry document received a full control resync at generation 4, kept the installed v1 definition after the real v2 update, and answered that AUTO and IDEATE were active. The disposable verifier exited 0.

assertions.evidence: Cupboard returned install v1 then update v2 with retainedVersions=[1.0.1,1.0.0]. Native home repair returned pinned-source-stale and preservedSpecificationRevision=89c2995e921f446dfe0f6db4a55e5c6e34cc8079cb8de7ce5eb5747cb399d21d. Codex thread 01a0d836-8821-7390-a347-7fecb5bffd24 completed its first and resumed model turns, quoting the v1 marker; the resumed turn received IDEATE. The isolated adv_sessions launch pin retained sourceRevision=2e036f854fb7e550daf545c60770dabb4d6acf95eb6f2268e2e3c07eef8a3ce4.

buildCarryDoc for the exact disposable owner returned session modes=[ideate] and automaticRecovery.marker.complete=true with controlGeneration=3. renderCarryDoc wrote 5,789 bytes, SHA-256 5306d5eaaf27eee1973675301111ed6b16db2fc993d9d23263c4b007ac6fc3bb. The builder uses the existing rearmControlWitnessForContextWipe seam for a context wipe.

Native mode:set enabled AUTO after the carry document was built. A fresh Codex thread 01a0d837-f855-7f52-ac60-3caf6acc8670 received that document as its first prompt. Its recorded developer injection contained CTRL:full-resync reason=generation-mismatch, previousGeneration=2, generation=4, modes=[auto,ideate], plus an su.mode-auto stack attachment. The prompt asked for active modes without naming either one; the completed model reply quoted P006 INSTALLED V1 DEFINITION and listed auto and ideate. The fresh-turn JSONL SHA-256 was c7509eeb8f14d7b66219d3deb060c715c84a8e3ae18617df65f05302224a3d59.

operatorPlane: current-build frozen host, disposable Tauri/Postgres, native Codex model turns, existing carry builder
limitation: The fresh Codex process was invoked directly with the actual buildCarryDoc output; this run did not exercise the automatic cold-loop scheduler or host respawn command. It does not prove Claude carry, fleet/GOAL holder replacement, generic identity isolation, or a full provider value receipt. The disposable transcripts and carry file are identified by hashes but were not retained as repository artifacts.
